edges.reason: Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, granting the caller unrestricted privileged control of the contract.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before kill() executes selfdestruct.
kill() depends on block.timestamp via require(now < 1522566000), a timestamp dependency condition.
onlyOwner guard checks msg.sender before updating entryFee.
onlyOwner guard checks msg.sender before updating processingFee.
onlyOwner guard checks msg.sender before updating registrationPeriod.
onlyOwner guard checks msg.sender before updating maxRacers.
onlyOwner guard checks msg.sender before toggling the pause switch.
onlyOwner guard checks msg.sender before repointing the external KittyCore contract.
registerForRace requires msg.sender == kittyCore.ownerOf(_kittyId) and uses msg.sender as the racer owner.
The caller-controlled msg.sender is the recipient of the raw send() processing fee transfer.
registerForRace invokes the external kittyCore.ownerOf call for authorization.
The _kittyId argument flows into the external ownerOf() lookup.
The external ownerOf result is returned into registerForRace ownership validation.
registerForRace appends the new Racer into races[raceId].racers.
registerForRace sets activeRacers[_kittyId] = true to lock the kitty in a race.
registerForRace performs raceId += 1 on a uint32 counter when a race completes or fills.
race() derives race scores from block.blockhash, an insecure randomness source.
race() performs a raw value transfer to the winner via send(), ignoring the returned status.
race() performs a raw value transfer of the processing fee back to msg.sender via send().
race() computes the winner payout with unchecked multiplication and subtraction.
race() computes the processing payout with unchecked multiplication.
race() indexes races[_raceId].racers[i] directly using the untrusted race id.
race() marks completedRaces[_raceId] = true after payout.
race() deletes races[_raceId] after the race finishes.
race() deletes activeRacers entries for each participating kitty.
race() calls the private getKittySkillScore helper for every racer.
getKittySkillScore performs the external kittyCore.getKitty call.
getKittySkillScore reads the geneMasks table to accumulate the skill score.
kill() executes selfdestruct(owner), destroying the contract.
The owner address receives the remaining balance from selfdestruct.
The selected winner racer supplies the recipient address for the send() payout.
The Racer struct assembled in registerForRace is pushed into storage.
The Race storage pointer is written to create/append the race entry.
raceScore accumulates gene and blockhash contributions inside race().
highScore tracks the leading score and selects the winner in race().
The loop index i drives the racer evaluation loop in race().
numRacers bounds the loop and the payout arithmetic in race().
The genes value is the input to the gene mask comparisons in getKittySkillScore.
skillScore is the accumulated return value of getKittySkillScore.
genes is destructured from the kittyCore.getKitty return tuple.
setEntryFee writes the _entryFee parameter into the entryFee state variable.
setProcessingFee writes the _processingFee parameter into processingFee.
setRegistrationPeriod writes the parameter into registrationPeriod.
setMaxRacers writes the parameter into maxRacers.
setGameOn writes the parameter into the gameOn pause switch.
The supplied address is stored into kittyCoreAddress.
The supplied address is cast into the kittyCore interface instance.
registrationPeriod is used in race() to decide whether enough time has passed to start.
maxRacers gates whether the race is full in race().
entryFee multiplies numRacers in the winner payout calculation.
processingFee multiplies numRacers in the processing payout calculation.
maxRacers determines when registerForRace rolls over to a new race.
registerForRace requires msg.value == entryFee before accepting a racer.
registerForRace requires the gameOn pause switch to be true.
The _raceId parameter selects which race storage entry race() operates on.
The _racerIndex parameter indexes the racer array in getRacer().
The _raceId parameter selects the race read by getRace().
The _raceId parameter selects the race read by getRacer().
send() transfers execution control back to the caller, allowing reentrancy before state finalization.

normalization_plan.reason: _kittyCoreAddress is a function parameter that directly configures the kittyCoreAddress/kittyCore state written by setKittyCoreAddress.
_entryFee is the input parameter of setEntryFee and only affects the entryFee state variable.
_processingFee is the input parameter of setProcessingFee and only affects processingFee.
_registrationPeriod is the input parameter of setRegistrationPeriod and only affects registrationPeriod.
_maxRacers is the input parameter of setMaxRacers and only affects maxRacers.
_gameOn is the input parameter of setGameOn and only affects the pause switch.
_raceId is a transient parameter consumed by race() to select the race being executed.
_racerIndex is a transient parameter used only for the array lookup inside getRacer().
_kittyId is the entry argument validated and stored by registerForRace.
racer is a temporary Racer struct whose only purpose is to be pushed into storage by registerForRace.
winner is a loop-local Racer that only exists to select the payout recipient inside race().
raceScore is a loop-local accumulator used only for scoring inside race().
highScore is a loop-local accumulator used only for winner selection inside race().
i is a trivial loop counter scoped to the racer loop in race().
numRacers is a locally cached copy of the racer count used only within race().
race is a storage pointer alias used only within registerForRace to write the race entry.
genes is a temporary value destructured from the external getKitty call inside getKittySkillScore.
skillScore is the local accumulator returned by getKittySkillScore.
